# JaegerGRS.com

Independent IT and development portfolio by Jaeger G.R. Stratton.

**Live URL:** https://jaegergrs.com/
**Hosting:** Cloudflare Worker `jaegergrs-portfolio` (custom domains `jaegergrs.com`, `www.jaegergrs.com`), serving the `public/` folder as static assets.
**Source:** Static HTML/CSS/JavaScript generated by a dependency-free Node script.

## Where things are

```
public/                  Everything that is deployed (what visitors get)
  index.html, 404.html, sitemap.xml, robots.txt
  about/ projects/ expertise/ contact/ changelog/   generated pages
  assets/                styles.css, main.js, favicon, share image, img/

src/
  worker.mjs             Cloudflare Worker: www redirect, security headers, CSP
  site/                  Page generator (edit content here)
    config.mjs           Version, date and every external URL (Svart, Grey Signal, JaeTheTech, socials)
    components.mjs       Shared HTML: header, footer, SEO tags, helpers
    build.mjs            Writes public/ pages and sitemap.xml
    pages/               One file per page group: home, projects, svart-security,
                         grey-signal, jaethetech, jae, hardware, expertise,
                         about, contact, changelog, not-found

scripts/                 check-site.mjs (links/CSP checks), test-worker.mjs
.github/workflows/       CI checks and optional Cloudflare deploy
wrangler.toml            Worker + static assets config
```

Site map: `/`, `/projects/` (`svart-security/`, `grey-signal/`, `jaethetech/`, `jae/`, `hardware/`), `/expertise/` (`hardware/`, `development/`), `/about/` (`journey/`), `/contact/`, `/changelog/`.

Each project page links out to the standalone site it describes. Grey Signal is self-hosted at an open IP over HTTP for now; change `GREY` in `src/site/config.mjs` when it has a domain.

## Editing

Edit `src/site/pages/*.mjs` (content) or `src/site/config.mjs`, then:

```bash
npm run generate   # rebuild public/ pages and sitemap
npm run check      # internal links, sitemap, CSP-unsafe inline styles/scripts
npm test           # Worker headers, redirects, image serving
npm run verify     # all three
npm run selfhost   # run the whole site and API on this PC (http://localhost:8787, also on your LAN)
npm run notes      # private page to jot change requests for Copilot Chat (password in notes/.password)
```

Do not hand-edit the generated `.html` files; commit them together with the source change (CI fails if they are out of date). Styles and scripts live directly in `public/assets/`.

## Deploy to Cloudflare

Cloudflare Pages Git integration returned `8000011` for this account, so production is a Worker deployed with Wrangler.

1. Create a scoped API token with **Workers Scripts Edit**. Never commit it.
2. Add repository secrets `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` and `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID`.
3. Set the Actions variable `CLOUDFLARE_DEPLOY_ENABLED` to `true`.
4. Push to `main`; the workflow validates and deploys.

Until step 3 is done, pushing to GitHub does not change the live site.

### Live PC panel and contact form

Both are Worker routes (`src/worker.mjs`) backed by Durable Objects.

- **Live PC panel** (`GET/POST /api/rig`): the PC app in [agent/](agent/README.md) posts with a secret key. Set it once with `npx wrangler secret put RIG_TOKEN` (32+ characters; make one with `node agent/rig-agent.mjs --gen-token`).
- **Contact form** (`POST /api/contact`): sends mail to `CONTACT_TO` (in `wrangler.toml`) via Cloudflare Email Service. Onboard `jaegergrs.com` for sending in the Cloudflare dashboard (Email Service) so `CONTACT_FROM` is allowed, or instead set `npx wrangler secret put RESEND_API_KEY`. Until one is set the form answers 503 and tells visitors to use email.
- Optional: `npx wrangler secret put GUARD_SALT` (any random string) to salt the hashed visitor keys used for rate limiting.

Local testing: put `RIG_TOKEN=...` in `.dev.vars` (git-ignored) and run `npx wrangler dev`.

## Security

The Worker adds a strict CSP (no inline scripts or styles, `form-action 'self'`), HSTS, COOP, `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, redirects `www` to the apex and serves `/.well-known/security.txt`. API routes are `no-store` with a locked-down CSP. The contact form checks the request origin, caps body size, uses a honeypot, strips header-injection characters and rate-limits per visitor (3 per 10 minutes, 8 per day). The PC key is compared in constant time and only whitelisted hardware fields are ever published.
